I tried to take my senior dog for emergency.  They would not even talk to me. Their backs turned away from me as I was literally standing in front of their reception. We left. As we were placing our baby in the car, a lady approached us and although seeing and hearing how scared I was, said they were closing and verbally recommended a place but with no specifics.  We were petrified with our sick baby.  Worse we were in unfamiliar territory as we were from out of town. NO GRACE OR COMPASSION.
I missed Dr Homer he was so awesome. the ladies that work there know you by name and they are very sweet and caring.

⭐ Very Disappointing First Impression

I called Southeast Animal Hospital to get a quote for heartworm treatment, and before I could even finish asking my questions, the person on the phone repeatedly talked over me. Her tone came across as irritated and as though helping me was an inconvenience.

I was simply trying to get information about an important treatment for my dog. If this is how a potential client is treated over the phone, it definitely doesn’t make me feel comfortable trusting them with my pet’s care.

A little patience and basic customer service would have made a huge difference. Unfortunately, this interaction was enough for me to take my business elsewhere.

Updating my review after working with them more: they are very reliable and straightforward. Appointments are efficient and low-stress for a pet, or as low stress as they can make it. Everyone seems very comfortable and well-seasoned in working with the animals. I appreciate having a reliable place for my pet to receive care.
They were very understanding and helpful ww were told a 2 hour wait and we were out of there within under an hour

I didn't feel comfortable taking my pet here after a receptionist was rude to me over the phone when I was asking basic questions politely. I understand customer see service can be hard their are real pain in the butts out there, but take a moment and put yourself in your next clients shoes of what they may be going through with their pets. Reset yourself, and give it all you've got.

My French bulldog and I have been to this office twice now, since moving to San Antonio.  The staff is friendly and I have been satisfied with the care and needs given to my little Luna.  The rooms and waiting room area are always spotless and do not smell like other vets I have been too. This is our new vet office in San Antonio and am happy to have found such a clean, affordable and caring staff to treat our Luna!
Chiquita has been getting care there's since she was 5wks old. She is now 15yrs old. Dr Homer, Desiree,Susan are very caring  Victor the groomer is also great. Wouldn't take my baby anywhere else

I've been coming to this animal hospital since about 2007. They got my dog through parvo as a puppy and she lived a long and happy life. They neutered my 2 male cats, no issues. I currently take my cats for their yearly exams and any other issues that they have. This animal hospital is amazing. Dr. Homer was the best vet and I have no doubt that his staff will continue to carry on his memory of helping these animals and giving them the best care.
Was seen in a timely manner and they were very kind and caring with my dog, George.
I took my dog zeus in he has been in bad shape. I followed drs orders and he's getting better.

I took my dog here for the first time here to have her shot update and get her heartworm and flea pills. They couldn't have been nicer. They tested her for heartworms and even cut her nails for free. They offer grooming services. I'm very happy they're only a block away since I have no car. 5 stars.

Most caring staff and so gentle with my fur baby when I took her in. I highly recommend this place for your pets care.

I been at this hospital for about 5 years + also recommended family members , before I stop coming here .. I was okay with it here until the over charges and half exams , my final straw was when this lady tried to charge me double on cutting my pets nails after cutting them instead of up charging me before the procedure I would’ve went somewhere else . charging me double just for a dogs nail cut is ridiculous, especially AFTER telling me to original price and coming back with double of the amount and they weren’t even cut close to where they should’ve been cut . Do better guys .
Love this place! They have been our vet for over 10 yrs
Saved our dog's life but they were also rude about it

Checked in at 7:45am and the receptionist was rude and sarcastic. A vet came rushing in late and scared my dog. As soon as he barked, they said he’d have to be put under to be examined! The "vet" told us I should use be using a choke collar so he’d “respect” me, even after I said we were there for breathing problems! My dog’s been through obedience training, he just picked up on that bad energy.

Don’t trust such apathetic people to care for your family. We went to Alamo Dog & Cat Hospital on Pleasanton instead, and they were amazing — my dog didn’t bark once!

Forgot to leave a review, but had took in my sick cat a couple of weeks ago.. They were able to let me bring her in same day. They took care of her right away. Thank you so much to the Vet & Staff for saving my little one/my support cat. I don't know what I would have done w/ out her.. She has been doing well now & back to her cuddly & happy self.. So very Grateful for all you've done... Hero too.. Prices were reasonable as well.. & Thank you so much for the courtesy call after😌❤️

The people here are caring and truly want your fur baby to be happy and healthy. We definitely recommend this vet for all your pet needs.
